data.name: Query_CaneUnloadingExpensesDetailReport
data.value:
--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-05 00:00:00:000'
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Description ,isnull(UnLoadingRate,0) as Rate , 'Per 100 Maunds' as Unit,isnull(sum(Amount),0) as Amount ,CONCAT (FORMAT(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'MMM'),'-',FORMAT(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'yy')) as Month
from Cane_UnloadingContractor
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Cane_UnloadingContractor.ContractorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
where Cane_UnloadingContractor.Status = 1 and Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Cane_UnloadingContractor.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate and @ToDate group by CONCAT (FORMAT(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'MMM'),'-',FORMAT(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'yy')) ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,UnLoadingRate

data.name: Query_ClearedAndUnclearedTransaction_Report
data.value:
--DECLARE @FromDate DATE = '2025-01-21', -- @ToDate DATE = '2025-02-21'
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration) as Narration, CASE WHEN AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate IS NULL THEN 'Un-Cleared' ELSE 'Cleared' END as PaymentStatus, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName AS PaymentMethod, CAST(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DATE) as PaymentDate, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo as ChequeNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo, --UPPER(substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) --+right ('0'+convert(nvarchar(2), DATEPART(mm, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),2 ) --+ (case when Len(convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo))<2 then '000'+convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) --when Len(convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo))<3 then '00'+convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) --else convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) end) )as VoucherNo, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTYpe ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType ,CAST(AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate AS DATE) AS ActivityDate From AP_PaymentHeader LEFT Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID = 1 And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Bank On AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID And AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
LEFT Join AR_SET_Customer On AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BankAccount On AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID And AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTYpeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OPeratingUnitID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentMethodID
Where AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {2} AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID IN (@CompanyID) AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0}
UNION ALL
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Comments,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments) as Narration, CASE WHEN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate IS NULL THEN 'Un-Cleared' ELSE 'Cleared' END as PaymentStatus, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName AS PaymentMethod, CAST(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DATE) as PaymentDate, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo as ChequeNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo, --UPPER(substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) --+right ('0'+convert(nvarchar(2), DATEPART(mm, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),2 ) --+ (case when Len(convert(varchar(24),AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo))<2 then '000'+convert(varchar(24),AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) --when Len(convert(varchar(24),AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo))<3 then '00'+convert(varchar(24),AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) --else convert(varchar(24),AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) end) )as VoucherNo, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTYpe ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType ,CAST(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate AS DATE) AS ActivityDate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader
Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Bank On AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID And AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
LEFT Join AR_SET_Customer On AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BankAccount On AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID And AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTYpeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OPeratingUnitID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptMethodID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {3} AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID IN (@CompanyID) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1}

data.name: Query_EmployeeBankAdvice
data.value:
select convert( varchar(20), HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID )+'-'+ convert( varchar(20), HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode )as PaySlipNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.IBanNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CNICNumber ,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo , AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName --,CustomerBank.BankName + ' - ' + CustomerBranch.BankBranchName as CustomerBank ,CustomerBank.BankAccountName as CustomerBank ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CreatedByValue as UserName
FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader ON HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1
RIGHT JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Bank on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = 1 And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_EmployeeType ON SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonTypeCode AND SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayment ON HRMS_EmployeePayment.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.EmpPaymentID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount CustomerBank On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = CustomerBank.BankBranchID And CustomerBank.PeriodID = 1 And CustomerBank.Status = 1
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID {0}

data.name: Query_EmployeeBankAdviceBeforeScroll
data.value:
select convert( varchar(20), HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID )+'-'+ convert( varchar(20), HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode )as PaySlipNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode ,HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.IBanNo ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CNICNumber --,HRMS_EmployeePayment.ChequeNo ,(select max(ChequeNo) from HRMS_EmployeePayment HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner inner join HRMS_Set_Employee HRMS_Set_Employeeinner on HRMS_Set_Employeeinner.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner.PaymentPersonID AND HRMS_Set_Employeeinner.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner.CompanyID AND HRMS_Set_Employeeinner.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner.PaymentType = 1 AND HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner.PaymentMonth BETWEEN @FromDate and @ToDate --AND HRMS_EmployeePaymentinner.PaymentDate BETWEEN DATEADD(month, 1, @FromDate) and DATEADD(month, 1,@ToDate) where HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employeeinner.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employeeinner.PersonID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID ) as ChequeNo --,case when HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount%10 = 9 then ROUND(HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount,-1) else HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount end as NetAmount --,round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.GrossAmount,0) - round(HRMS_SalaryHeader.DeductionAmount,0)as NetAmount
,isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode = 1),0)
- isnull((select (sum(isnull(HRMS_SalaryDetail.Amount,0))) from HRMS_SalaryDetail where HRMS_SalaryDetail.SalaryHeaderID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryHeaderID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.Status = 1 and HRMS_SalaryDetail.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryDetail.PayrollTypeCode in (2,5)),0) as NetAmount
,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo , AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate ,HRMS_Set_Employee.CreatedByValue as UserName FROM HRMS_Set_Employee
INNER JOIN HRMS_SalaryHeader ON HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID And HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1
right join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankBranch.status =1
left JOIN AR_SET_Bank on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_BankAccountID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
LEFT Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_EmployeeType ON SET_EmployeeType.TypeID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonTypeCode AND SET_EmployeeType.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_EmployeePayment ON HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID -- AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID -- AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentType = 1 -- AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentDate BETWEEN @FromDate and @ToDate
where HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo is not null and len(trim(HRMS_Set_Employee.EmpAccountNo)) > 1 and HRMS_SalaryHeader.NetAmount > 0 {0}

data.name: Query_GetAllDataBankGuaranteesSummaryDetail
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @Dateto datetime = '2021-03-16 00:00:00:000'
Select final.BankName , (case when final.Limit != 0 then final.Outstanding else 0 end) as Outstanding ,final.Limit ,( final.Limit - (case when final.Limit != 0 then Abs(final.Outstanding) else 0 end) ) as Balance ,final.PeriodSetName from (
select tb.BankName as BankName ,isnull((SUM(ResultValue)),0) Outstanding ,Isnull((select distinct SUM(Amount) from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)),0) as Limit
,(Isnull((select distinct SUM(Amount) from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)),0))
-
isnull(ABS(SUM(ResultValue)),0)
as Balance
, (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as PeriodSetName from (
Select Distinct tab.BankBranchID, SUM(tab.ResultValue) as ResultValue ,tab.BankName From ( Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) ResultValue ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID in ((select distinct BankID from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc))) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto
Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) * -1 ResultValue ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID in ((select distinct BankID from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc))) and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto
Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When ReceiptData.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) Else IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) * -1 End As ResultValue ,ReceiptData.PeriodSetName, ReceiptData.BankName
From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select distinct AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,AR_SET_Bank.BankName
,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptBankID
From AR_ReceiptBanksDetail Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID in ((select distinct BankID from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc))) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID
Where AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As ReceiptData On ReceiptData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And ReceiptData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And ReceiptData.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON ReceiptData.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND ReceiptData.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND ReceiptData.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When PaymentData.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) * -1 Else IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) End As ResultValue ,PaymentData.PeriodSetName, PaymentData.BankName
From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select distinct AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,AR_SET_Bank.BankName
,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo ,AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentBankID
From AP_PaymentBanksDetail Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID in ((select distinct BankID from Set_BankGuarantee where StartDate between (select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc)
and
(select top 1 EndDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @Dateto between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc))) and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID

Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 {2} where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {1} ), 0) ) Payment from AR_SET_BankAccount Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 where AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport,0) = 1 {0} ) Bank group by BankAccountNumber, BankAccountName, BankBranchName, BankName

select UPPER(BankName) as BankName,UPPER(BankAccountNumber) As BankAccountName,UPPER( BankBranchName) as BankBranchName, sum(ResultValue) as Balance,UPPER(AccountName) as AccountName from ( Select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bank.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate IS NOT NULL {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName
UNION ALL
Select isnull(sum(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount Else AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
INNER Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail ON AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate IS NOT NULL {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName Union All
Select isnull(Sum(dbo.AP_PaymentHeader.Amount), 0) * -1 As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyID = (1) And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyId And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate IS NOT NULL {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName
UNION ALL
Select isnull(sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount End), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail ON AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate IS NOT NULL {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName ) tb group by BankName, BankAccountNumber, BankBranchName ,AccountName order by BankName Asc

Select tab.BankBranchID, tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber, SUM(tab.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance From ( Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 {4} UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) * -1 OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 {4} UNION ALL

UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When PaymentData.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) * -1 Else IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount From AP_PaymentBanksDetail Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID {1} Where AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As PaymentData On PaymentData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And PaymentData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 {4} )tab Group By tab.BankBranchID, tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber

SELECT BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID,BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationDetailID ,BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID as BankID ,BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID,AR_Set_Bank.BankName,AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName, Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) Else IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) * -1 End As TotOpeningBalance,BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, BankReconcilation_Detail.ChequeNo As PaymentServerOrderNo, BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentNo,BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentDate,ItemName,BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit AS CurrentBalanceDebit, BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit AS CurrentBalanceCredit,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedByBank,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedDifferentAmount ,BankReconcilation_Detail.NoteReportedAmount, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountCredit, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountDebit --,DocumentType ,Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance,0) else 0 End As OpeningBalance , '' as Description
FROM BankReconcilation_Header INNER JOIN BankReconcilation_Detail on BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_Set_Bank ON AR_Set_bank.BankID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount on AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID WHERE BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID = @BankReconcilationID
-- Not Reported SELECT BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID,BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationDetailID ,BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID as BankID,BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID,AR_Set_Bank.BankName,AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName, Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) Else IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) * -1 End As TotOpeningBalance,BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, BankReconcilation_Detail.ChequeNo As PaymentServerOrderNo, BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentNo,BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentDate,ItemName,BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit AS CurrentBalanceDebit, BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit AS CurrentBalanceCredit,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedByBank,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedDifferentAmount ,BankReconcilation_Detail.NoteReportedAmount, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountCredit, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountDebit --,DocumentType ,Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance,0) else 0 End As OpeningBalance , '' as Description
FROM BankReconcilation_Header INNER JOIN BankReconcilation_Detail on BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID
INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_Set_Bank ON AR_Set_bank.BankID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount on AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID WHERE BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID = @BankReconcilationID and BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedByBank = 0
-- Reported Different SELECT BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID,BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationDetailID ,BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID as BankID,BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID,AR_Set_Bank.BankName,AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName, Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) Else IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, 0) * -1 End As TotOpeningBalance,BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance, BankReconcilation_Detail.ChequeNo As PaymentServerOrderNo, BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentNo,BankReconcilation_Detail.DocumentDate,ItemName,BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit AS CurrentBalanceDebit, BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit AS CurrentBalanceCredit,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedByBank,BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedDifferentAmount ,BankReconcilation_Detail.NoteReportedAmount, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountCredit, 0 as ReportedDifferentAmountDebit --,DocumentType ,Case When BankReconcilation_Detail.ItemName = 'Opening Balance' Then IsNull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Balance,0) else 0 End As OpeningBalance , ''as Description
, case when isnull(ReportedDifferentAmount,0) > 0 and isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit,0) > 0 then ReportedDifferentAmount - BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit
when isnull(ReportedDifferentAmount,0) > 0 and isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit,0) > 0 then ReportedDifferentAmount + BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit
when isnull(NoteReportedAmount,0) > 0 and isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit,0) > 0 then BankReconcilation_Detail.Credit + NoteReportedAmount
when isnull(NoteReportedAmount,0) > 0 and isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit,0) > 0 then BankReconcilation_Detail.Debit - NoteReportedAmount
else 0 end as QueryBalnce FROM BankReconcilation_Header INNER JOIN BankReconcilation_Detail on BankReconcilation_Detail.BankReconcilationID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_Set_Bank ON AR_Set_bank.BankID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount on AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID WHERE BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID = @BankReconcilationID and (isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.ReportedDifferentAmount,0) > 0 or isnull(BankReconcilation_Detail.NoteReportedAmount,0) > 0)
--Reported Different Amount
SELECT BankReconcilationSubDetail.BankReconcilationID, BankReconcilationSubDetail.BankReconcilationSubDetailID, BankReconcilationSubDetail.ReportedDifferentAmountCredit, BankReconcilationSubDetail.ReportedDifferentAmountDebit , BankReconcilationSubDetail.Description,BankReconcilation_Header.BankNameID as BankID,BankReconcilation_Header.BankBranchID, BankReconcilation_Header.BankAccountNameID
FROM BankReconcilationSubDetail INNER JOIN BankReconcilation_Header on BankReconcilationSubDetail.BankReconcilationID = BankReconcilation_Header.BankReconcilationID
WHERE BankReconcilationSubDetail.BankReconcilationID = @BankReconcilationID and (isnull(BankReconcilationSubDetail.ReportedDifferentAmountDebit,0) > 0 or isnull(BankReconcilationSubDetail.ReportedDifferentAmountCredit,0) > 0) And BankReconcilationSubDetail.Status= 1

Select 123 as ReportLinkNo, tab2.ChequeStatus,tab2.BankAccountID, tab2.DocumentNo, tab2.DocumentDate, SUM(tab2.ReceiptAmount) + SUM(tab2.PaymentAmount) Amount, tab2.DocumentType, tab2.InstrumentNo, InstrumentDate,tab2.Comments, tab2.BankAccountNumber ,tab2.BankID,unPosted,ActivityDate,IssueDate From ( Select 'Cheque Not Deposit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount ReceiptAmount, 0 as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo As InstrumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.AntiCipatedClearingDate as InstrumentDate, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,'' as BankID , case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Opening%' -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate> @ToDate) -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate) {0} {2}
UNION ALL Select 'Cheque Deposit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount ReceiptAmount, 0 as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo As InstrumentNo,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.AntiCipatedClearingDate as InstrumentDate, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,'' as BankID , case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Opening%' -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is not null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate <= @ToDate) {0} {2}
UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque in Transit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0 as ReceiptAmount, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo As InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.AntiCipatedClearingDate as InstrumentDate, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,'' as BankID , case AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate,AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND (AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is not null -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is not null AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate <= @ToDate) -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is not null {1} {2}
UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque In Hand' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0 as ReceiptAmount, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo As InstrumentNo,AP_PaymentHeader.AntiCipatedClearingDate as InstrumentDate, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,'' as BankID , case AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate,AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is null AND (AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND (AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate> @ToDate) AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate) {1} {2}
UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque Not Deposit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, (Case when AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as ReceiptAmount, (Case when AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentDate, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptBankID as BankID , case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptBanksDetail ON AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Opening%' -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate> @ToDate) -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate ) {0} {2}
UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque Deposit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, (Case when AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as ReceiptAmount, (Case when AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentDate, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptBankID as BankID , case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptBanksDetail ON AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate is not null AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.IssueDate<=@ToDate)
{0} {2}
UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque in Hand' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, (Case when AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as ReceiptAmount, (Case when AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentDate, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentBankID as BankID , case AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate,AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN AP_PaymentBanksDetail ON AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND (AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate> @ToDate) -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is null AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate) {1} {2} UNION ALL
Select 'Cheque In Transit' as ChequeStatus,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, (Case when AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as ReceiptAmount, (Case when AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount else 0 end) as PaymentAmount, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentDate,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentBankID as BankID , case AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 1 else 0 end as unPosted ,AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate,AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN AP_PaymentBanksDetail ON AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID -- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
AND (AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate is null OR AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate> @ToDate) AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate is not null -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND AP_PaymentHeader.IssueDate<=@ToDate) {1} {2}
)tab2 where InstrumentDate is not null Group By tab2.DocumentType, tab2.BankAccountID, tab2.DocumentNo, tab2.DocumentDate, tab2.InstrumentNo, tab2.Comments, tab2.BankAccountNumber,tab2.BankID,unPosted , tab2.ChequeStatus,ActivityDate,IssueDate,InstrumentDate order by tab2.DocumentDate
--2nd Query
--- Copy Query Of Bank reconciliation Summary
Select ReportLinkNo, 1 as SerialNo, 'Balance As Per Bank Ledger' as Description, isnull(sum(Amount), 0) as BalanceAsPerBankStatment, Case when Description = 'Balance As Per Bank Ledger' then isnull(sum(Balance), 0) else 0 end as Balance from
(
Select 0 as Amount, * from (
select 123 as ReportLinkNo, 1 as SerialNo,'Balance As Per Bank Ledger' AS Description, ISNULL(sum(ResultValue),0) as Balance
from ( Select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
-- INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bank.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null --and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankStatusReport, 0) = 1 {0} {2}

select finaltab.AccountName,sum(finaltab.Balance)Amount from ( select UPPER(BankName) as BankName,UPPER(BankAccountNumber) As BankAccountName,UPPER( BankBranchName) as BankBranchName, sum(ResultValue) as Balance,UPPER(AccountName) as AccountName from ( Select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bank.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null --and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankStatusReport, 0) = 1 AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName

INNER Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail ON AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto -- and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankStatusReport, 0) = 1 AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName Union All
Select isnull(Sum(dbo.AP_PaymentHeader.Amount), 0) * -1 As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyID = (1) And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyId And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto ---and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankStatusReport,0) = 1 AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName
UNION ALL
Select isnull(sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount End), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName as AccountName From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail ON AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto --and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankStatusReport,0) = 1 AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0}
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountName ) tb group by BankName, BankAccountNumber, BankBranchName ,AccountName
) as FinalTAB

select TAB.Type, TAB.SortCategory, TAB.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, TAB.BanKName, TAB.VoucherNo, TAB.ChequeNo,TAB.Narration, TAB.ReceiptName, convert(decimal(18,0), TAB.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, convert(decimal(18,0), TAB.OpeningBalance) as Balance from ( ---------- Opening Balance ---------- Select 'Opening Balance ---)' AS Type, 1 AS SortCategory, tab.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo,'' AS Narration, '' AS ReceiptName, SUM(tab.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance From ( Select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} {1} {2}

--Receipts SELECT 'RECEIPTS' AS Type, 2 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo,'' AS Narration, (ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, '')) AS ReceiptName, Cast(ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 {0} {1} {2} GROUP BY AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount
Union All

SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' {0} {1} {2}

= SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' {0} {1} {3}
UNION ALL -- Total Receipts SELECT DISTINCT 'Total Receipts ----)' AS Type, 3 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo, '' AS Narration, '' AS ReceiptName, Cast(ISNULL( ( Select Sum(Tab.Amount) From ( SELECT SUM(rh.Amount) As Amount FROM AR_SET_Bank bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch branch ON branch.BankID = bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ba ON ba.BankBranchID = branch.BankBranchID Inner JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader rh ON rh.BankAccountID = ba.BankAccountID AND rh.CompanyID = ba.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = ba.PeriodID And rh.Status = 1 And rh.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON rh.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND rh.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE bank.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID AND branch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID AND rh.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND rh.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate {1} {4} Union All
