-- TOTAl PAYMENT Receipt SELECT 'Total Receipts ----)' AS Type, 3 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo,
'' AS ChequeNo, '' AS Narration, '' AS ReceiptName,
sum(Cast(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 Else ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) End As decimal(18,0))) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID Inner JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' {0} {1} {3} group by AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID,AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName
union all
---- Last Cheque No --SELECT DISTINCT 'Last Cheque No ----)' AS Type, 4 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo, -- '' AS ReceiptName, Cast(ISNULL( -- ( -- SELECT Top 1 ph.PaymentServerOrderNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader ph -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ba ON ba.CompanyID = ph.CompanyID And ba.PeriodID = ph.PeriodID And ba.BankAccountID = ph.BankAccountID -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch branch ON branch.BankBranchID = ba.BankBranchID -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank bank ON bank.BankID = branch.BankID -- WHERE ph.PaymentServerOrderNo IS NOT NULL AND ph.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ph.DocumentDate <= @FromDate -- AND bank.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID And branch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID
-- Order By ph.CreateDate desc -- ), 0) As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance --FROM AR_SET_Bank -- Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID -- Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID -- And AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1
--GROUP BY AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName
--UNION ALL
-- PAYMENTS SELECT 'PAYMENTS' AS Type, 5 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo AS VoucherNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, 0) AS ChequeNo,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments AS Narration , (ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, '')) AS ReceiptName, Cast(ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 {0} {1} {3}
UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT Banks SELECT 'PAYMENTS' AS Type, 5 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo AS VoucherNo, --ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, 0) AS ChequeNo, case when AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo is null then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo else AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo end AS ChequeNo, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments AS Narration, (ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, '')) AS ReceiptName, Cast(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) Else ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 End As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID Inner JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' {0} {1} {3}
union all
--Receipts Bank SELECT 'PAYMENTS' AS Type, 5 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Comments as Narration, (ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, '')) AS ReceiptName, Cast(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ISNULL(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount, 0) Else ISNULL(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 End As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID Inner JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' {0} {1} {2}
UNION ALL
-- TOTAl PAYMENT SELECT 'Total Payments ----)' AS Type, 6 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo,
'' AS ChequeNo, '' AS Narration, '' AS ReceiptName,
sum(Cast(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) Else ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 End As decimal(18,0))) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID Inner JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' {0} {1} {3} group by AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName
union all
-- Total Receipts Receitp SELECT DISTINCT 'Total Payments ----)' AS Type, 6 AS SortCategory, AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo, ''as Narration, '' AS ReceiptName, Cast(ISNULL( ( Select Sum(Tab.Amount) From ( SELECT SUM(rh.Amount) As Amount FROM AR_SET_Bank bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch branch ON branch.BankID = bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ba ON ba.BankBranchID = branch.BankBranchID Inner JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader rh ON rh.BankAccountID = ba.BankAccountID AND rh.CompanyID = ba.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = ba.PeriodID And rh.Status = 1 And rh.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON rh.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND rh.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE bank.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID AND branch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID AND rh.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND rh.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate {1} {4}
Union All
SELECT SUM(Case When rb.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ISNULL(rb.Amount, 0) Else ISNULL(rb.Amount, 0) End) As Amount FROM AR_SET_Bank bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch branch ON branch.BankID = bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ba ON ba.BankBranchID = branch.BankBranchID Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail rb On rb.CompanyID = ba.CompanyID And rb.PeriodID = ba.PeriodID And rb.BankAccountID = ba.BankAccountID Inner JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader rh ON rh.ReceiptTransactionID = rb.ReceiptHeaderID AND rh.CompanyID = rb.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = rb.PeriodID And rh.Status = 1 And rh.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON rh.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND rh.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE bank.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID AND branch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID AND rh.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND rh.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND rh.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND rb.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.bankaccountid and rb.TransactionType = 'Credit' {1} {4} ) As Tab ), 0) As decimal(18,0)) AS OpeningBalance FROM AR_SET_Bank Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID Inner JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID --And AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 --{1} {0}
GROUP BY AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName ,AR_Set_bankAccount.DocumentGroupID UNION ALL ---------- Closing Balance ---------- Select 'Closing Balance ---)' AS Type, 7 AS SortCategory, tab.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo, '' as Narration,'' AS ReceiptName, SUM(tab.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance From ( Select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} {1} {2}
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) * -1 OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} {1} {3}
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When ReceiptData.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) Else IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) * -1 End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount From AR_ReceiptBanksDetail Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} Where AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {1} {2} ) As ReceiptData On ReceiptData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And ReceiptData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 {0} --{1}
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When PaymentData.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) * -1 Else IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount From AP_PaymentBanksDetail Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {6} Where AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID {1} {3} ) As PaymentData On PaymentData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And PaymentData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.ShowInBankReport = 1 {0} --{1} )tab Group By tab.BankBranchID, tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber ,tab.BankID,tab.BankName
--------- END Closing -------- ) AS TAB
select IMP_PledgeBags.BankName,IMP_PledgeBags.AccountNo, sum(IMP_PledgeBags.PledgeBags)- isnull(( select sum(IMP_UnPledgeBags.UnPledgeBags) from IMP_UnPledgeBags where IMP_UnPledgeBags.BankID = IMP_PledgeBags.BankID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.AccountID = IMP_PledgeBags.AccountID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.CompanyID = IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.Status = 1
),0) as Balance from IMP_PledgeBags where IMP_PledgeBags.Status = 1 and IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID in @CompanyID group by IMP_PledgeBags.BankName,IMP_PledgeBags.BankID,IMP_PledgeBags.AccountID,IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID,IMP_PledgeBags.AccountNo

data.name: Query_Get_DailyCashPosition
data.value:
select TAB.Type, TAB.SortCategory, TAB.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, TAB.BanKName, TAB.VoucherNo, TAB.ChequeNo,TAB.Narration, TAB.ReceiptName, convert(decimal(18,0), TAB.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance, convert(decimal(18,0), TAB.OpeningBalance) as Balance from ( ---------- Opening Balance ----------
Select 'Opening Balance ---)' AS Type, 1 AS SortCategory, tab.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo ,'' as Narration, '' AS ReceiptName, SUM(tab.OpeningAmount) as OpeningBalance
from (
Select 'Opening Balance ---)' AS Type, 1 AS SortCategory, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID as BankID, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID as BankAccountID,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName as BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo, '' AS ReceiptName,
isnull(( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @fromDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID ),0)
+

Select distinct 'Closing Balance ---)' AS Type, 7 AS SortCategory, tab.BankID, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankName, 0 AS VoucherNo, '' AS ChequeNo,'' AS Narration, '' AS ReceiptName, sum(OpeningAmount) + sum(ReceiptAmount) - sum(Payment) as OpeningBalance From (
select 'Opening Balance ---)' AS Type,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName As BankName, AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @fromDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount Else AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @fromDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) - (isnull( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @fromDate AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @fromDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0)) OpeningAmount, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) Total from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID =AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID= AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @toDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) ReceiptAmount, ( ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) From AP_PaymentHeader --INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID --And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID -- AND AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = @BranchID ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID --And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 {1} {6} --Inner Join UsersInDocumentType On UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID --And UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID And UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
), 0) ) Payment from AR_SET_BankAccount Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankAccount.IsShowInCashReport = 1 {0} --{1}
)tab Group By tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber ,tab.BankID,tab.BankName
--------- END Closing -------- ) AS TAB

data.name: Query_LetterOfCreadit
data.value:
select AR_SET_Bank .BankName,inv_item.description as Itemdescription,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as POImportNo ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo,SET_Currency .CurrencyName as Currency,FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.NetAmount as Value from FA_LetterOfCreditHeader inner join FA_LetterOfCreditDetail on FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.LCHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCHeaderID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID and SET_Currency.Status = 1
inner join inv_item on inv_item.itemid = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.ItemID and inv_item.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditDetail.CompanyID and inv_item.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankID and AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_LetterOfGuarantee
data.value:
select UPPER(BankName) as BankName,Beneficiary,GuaranteeNo,Abs(sum(ResultValue)) as Outstanding,RenewalDate,Expirydate from ( Select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,(Set_BankGuarantee.Amount) as Limit ,( select top 1 AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 --And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID = @businessPartnerID ) as Beneficiary
,( select top 1 Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.GuaranteeNo from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 ) as GuaranteeNo ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate as RenewalDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate as Expirydate From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID
And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join Set_BankGuarantee on Set_BankGuarantee.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID
inner join Set_BankGuaranteeDetail on Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bank.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null {0} --And AR_SET_Bank.BankID = @BankID
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,Set_BankGuarantee.Amount ,Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID ,Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate,Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID
UNION ALL
Select Distinct isnull(sum(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount Else AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,(Set_BankGuarantee.Amount) as Limit ,( select top 1 AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 --And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID = @businessPartnerID ) as Beneficiary ,( select top 1 Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.GuaranteeNo from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 ) as GuaranteeNo ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate as RenewalDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate as Expirydate From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
INNER Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail ON AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID
inner join Set_BankGuarantee on Set_BankGuarantee.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID
inner join Set_BankGuaranteeDetail on Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto {0} --And AR_SET_Bank.BankID = @BankID
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,Set_BankGuarantee.Amount ,Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID ,Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate,Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID Union All
Select isnull(Sum(dbo.AP_PaymentHeader.Amount), 0) * -1 As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,(Set_BankGuarantee.Amount) as Limit ,( select top 1 AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 --And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID = @businessPartnerID ) as Beneficiary ,( select top 1 Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.GuaranteeNo from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 ) as GuaranteeNo ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate as RenewalDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate as Expirydate From AR_Set_bank Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID = AR_Set_bank.BankID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyID = (1) And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyId And AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join Set_BankGuarantee on Set_BankGuarantee.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID
inner join Set_BankGuaranteeDetail on Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto {0} --And AR_SET_Bank.BankID = @BankID
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,Set_BankGuarantee.Amount ,Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID ,Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate,Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID UNION ALL
Select Distinct isnull(sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount End), 0) As ResultValue, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,(Set_BankGuarantee.Amount) as Limit ,( select top 1 AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 --And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID = @businessPartnerID ) as Beneficiary ,( select top 1 Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.GuaranteeNo from Set_BankGuaranteeDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID where Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID and Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1 ) as GuaranteeNo ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate as RenewalDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate as Expirydate From AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail ON AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID is not null Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID
inner join Set_BankGuarantee on Set_BankGuarantee.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID
inner join Set_BankGuaranteeDetail on Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID And Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_Set_bank.status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @Dateto {0} --And AR_SET_Bank.BankID = @BankID
group by AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_Set_bank.BankName, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName ,Set_BankGuarantee.Amount ,Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID ,Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID ,Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate ,Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate,Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID ) tb group by BankName ,Beneficiary,GuaranteeNo,RenewalDate,Expirydate order by BankName Asc

data.name: Query_LimeSlakerExpenses
data.value:
select case when ActivityTypeID = 1 then 'Salaries and wages of Own labour' else 'Contractor' end as Description ,case when ActivityTypeID = 1 then sum(OwnLabour) else sum(Rate) end as Rate , case when ActivityTypeID = 1 then 'Labour P.M' else 'Per Month' end as Unit,sum(Contractor) as Amount ,CONCAT (FORMAT(EffectedFromDate,'MMM'),'-',FORMAT(EffectedFromDate,'yy')) as Month
from Set_LimeSlaker
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_LimeSlaker.EffectedFromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID
where Set_LimeSlaker.Status = 1 and Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_LimeSlaker.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Set_LimeSlaker.EffectedFromDate BETWEEN @FromDate and @ToDate group by Set_LimeSlaker.ActivityTypeID,CONCAT (FORMAT(EffectedFromDate,'MMM'),'-',FORMAT(EffectedFromDate,'yy'))

data.name: Query_PaymentDetails_Report
data.value:
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Bank.BankName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, ISNULL(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration) as Narration, 'Cleared' as PaymentStatus, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName AS PaymentMethod, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PaymentDate, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo as ChequeNo, --AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo, UPPER(substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) +right ('0'+convert(nvarchar(2), DATEPART(mm, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),2 ) + (case when Len(convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo))<2 then '000'+convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) when Len(convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo))<3 then '00'+convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) else convert(varchar(24),AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo) end) )as VoucherNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTYpe ,AP_PaymentHeader.ActivityDate From AP_PaymentHeader Inner Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Bank On AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID And AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BankAccount On AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID And AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTYpeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OPeratingUnitID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentMethodID
Where AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @fromDate And @ToDate {0}

data.name: Query_SummaryOfDailyFundsPosition
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2020-06-13 00:00:00:000'
select @AsOnDate as AsOnDate,* from (
select LoanType , LimitName, BankName, AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankAccountNumber, EndDate, (Amount / 1000000) as Amount ,(case when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Monthly' then 12 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Quarterly' then 4 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'HalfYearly' then 2 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Yearly' then 1 else 0 end ) as MarkupBasis
,(select top 1 InterestRate from Set_BankFacilityDetail where BankFacilityHeaderID = Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID and Status = 1 and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID order by BankFacilityDetailID desc ) as Pricing
,Isnull((select SUM(isnull(IMP_PledgeBags.PledgeBags,0)) - SUM(isnull(IMP_UnPledgeBags.UnPledgeBags,0)) from IMP_PledgeBags inner join IMP_UnPledgeBags on IMP_UnPledgeBags.PledgeBagsID = IMP_PledgeBags.PledgeBagsId and IMP_UnPledgeBags.CompanyID = IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.PeriodID = IMP_PledgeBags.PeriodID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.BankID = IMP_PledgeBags.BankID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.AccountID = IMP_PledgeBags.AccountID and IMP_UnPledgeBags.Status = IMP_PledgeBags.Status where IMP_PledgeBags.status = 1 and IMP_PledgeBags.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID --and IMP_PledgeBags.AccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID ),0) as PledgedBags
,isnull((
Select --Distinct tab.BankBranchID,UPPER(tab.BankBranchName) AS BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID,UPPER( tab.BankAccountNumber) AS BankAccountNumber, SUM(tab.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance From ( Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankBranchID AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankAccountID
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) * -1 OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
--AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankBranchID And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankAccountID
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When ReceiptData.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) Else IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) * -1 End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID From AR_ReceiptBanksDetail Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID --AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankBranchID AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Where AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As ReceiptData On ReceiptData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And ReceiptData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And ReceiptData.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON ReceiptData.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND ReceiptData.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND ReceiptData.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankAccountID
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When PaymentData.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) * -1 Else IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID From AP_PaymentBanksDetail Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID -- AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankBranchID And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Where AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As PaymentData On PaymentData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And PaymentData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And PaymentData.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON PaymentData.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND PaymentData.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND PaymentData.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankAccountID )tab Group By tab.BankBranchID, tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber ),0) as Availed
,Isnull(( Select SUM(Isnull(t.TransactionWiseMarkUP,0)) from ( Select Isnull(((tab.OpeningBalance * (select top 1 InterestRate from Set_BankFacilityDetail where BankFacilityHeaderID = Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID and Status = 1 and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID order by BankFacilityDetailID desc ) * (case when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Monthly' then 12 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Quarterly' then 4 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'HalfYearly' then 2 when Set_BankFacility.Markup = 'Yearly' then 1 else 0 end ) ) / 100 / 365),0) as TransactionWiseMarkUP
From ( Select SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID -- AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccountOuter.BankBranchID AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID

LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
and (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) not in (select distinct LocationID from set_location where LocationName like '%yard%' and status = 1))
AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) <= @AsOnDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ) as TAB
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName,
isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity,
(case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end )TransactionCost,
CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN
(case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end )
ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice,
SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) AS Amount,
case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity,
CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') ) inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
and (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) not in (select distinct LocationID from set_location where LocationName like '%yard%' and status = 1)) AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) <= @AsOnDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ) as TAB
) as FinTAb where fintab.transactionquantity <> 0
)FinalSumQty
